title: Overlapping memory copy (c)
description: The code copies bytes with memcpy, which is undefined when the regions overlap. Overlap happens routinely when a buffer is shifted, truncated or reassembled in place, and the result is silent corruption rather than a crash. This lexical rule flags the copy; the reviewer checks whether the regions can overlap.
remediation: Use the overlap-safe variant for in-place moves, for example memmove for in-place copies, and assert non-overlap where the fast copy is kept.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches every copy, including provably disjoint ones.
